shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && find app -type f -maxdepth 8 -print && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!'"\\.next' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat app/layout.tsx && cat app/page.tsx && cat components/request-metadata.tsx && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Operations|Deployment health|Loading request metadata|Request [0-9a-f]' .next/server/app -g '*.html' && git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && git ls-files && cat next-env.d.ts && rg -n 'instant\\s*=\\s*false|dynamic\\s*=|experimental_ppr|prefetch\\s*=' app components next.config.ts"
